title: ERA5 ARCO (Google/ECMWF), no CORS
description:
The Google/ECMWF ARCO-ERA5 full-resolution (0.25 deg, hourly) Zarr V2 archive, 1940-01-01 to present. Confirmed by `curl -I` with an `Origin` header: the GCS bucket returns no `Access-Control-Allow-Origin` header at all, so a browser `fetch()` for this store's metadata is blocked by CORS before any data request happens. `2m_temperature` is [time, latitude, longitude], shape [1323648, 721, 1440], chunked [1, 721, 1440] (well-chunked -- one time step per chunk; the amplification guard is not what blocks this store).

License: Copernicus/ECMWF data licence (not a standard SPDX license); declared "proprietary".

Expected browser outcome: a clear load error (CORS failure), surfaced promptly -- never a hang.
